title: Republic Act No. 12284
text:
H. No. 10408

Republic of the Philippines
Congress of the Philippines
Meteo Manila
Nineteenth Congress

Chirk Regular Session
———

Begun and held in Metro Manila, on Monday, the twenty-second
day of July, two thousand twenty-four.

[ REPUBLIC ACT No. 12284 ]

AN ACT CONVERTING THE EXTENSION CAMPUS OF THE
CEBU NORMAL UNIVERSITY IN THE MUNICIPALITY
OF MEDELLIN, PROVINCE OF CEBU INTO A REGULAR
CAMPUS AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR

Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the Philippines in
Congress assembled:

SECTION 1. Short Title. — This Act shall be known as the
“Cebu Normal University (CNU)-Medellin Campus Act”.

SEC. 2. Conversion into a Regular Campus. ~ The CNU
shall convert the extension campus located in the Municipality
of Medellin, Province of Cebu into a regular campus, to be known
as the “CNU-Medellin Campus”.

SEC. 3. General Mandate. — The CNU-Medellin Campus
shall primarily provide undergraduate and graduate courses such
 
as education, tourism, science and technology, agriculture,
forestry, environmental science, livelihood technology education,
public safety, water and coastal management, and such programs
within its areas of competency and specialization, pursuant to
the mandates of the CNU, and according to its capability, as the
Board of Regents, hereinafter referred to as the Board, may deem
necessary for the accomplishment of its objectives, and those
which respond to the human resource development needs of the
Province of Cebu and the Central Visayas Region. It shall be
mandated to undertake research and extension services in support of
the socioeconomic development and to provide progressive leadership
in these areas.

SEC. 4. Supervision and Management. — The University
President shall have overall supervision and management of
the CNU-Medellin Campus. The Campus shall be headed by a
Campus Director who shall be appointed by the Board, subject
to its guidelines, qualifications, and standards, and upon the
recommendation of a Search Committee duly constituted for
the purpose of selecting the Campus Director: Provided, That
pending submission of the report by the Search Committee duly
constituted by the Board, the University President shall designate
from among the faculty members or employees of the CNU to
serve as the Officer-in-Charge Campus Director or in acting
capacity subject to the confirmation by the Board and applicable
policies of the Civil Service Commission: Provided, however, That
in order to ensure smooth transition, the incumbent designated
Campus Director of the CNU-Medellin Campus, if qualified, shall
serve as the first Campus Director, subject to the pertinent provisions
of the University Code and Policies promulgated by the Board.

The Campus Director shall be assisted by a Dean who
shall be appointed or designated with the duties and functions
determined by the University President, subject to the confirmation
by the Board.

SEC. 5. Compliance with the Requirements of the Commission
on Higher Education (CHED). — The CNU shall ensure compliance
of the CNU-Medellin Campus with the policies, standards, and
guidelines of the CHED for the operation of the campus
including those related to the offering of courses and the introduction
of new or revised programs prior to the conversion.

SEC. 6. Management of Personnel, Assets and Records. ~ All
assets, both real and personal, personnel, and records of the
CNU-Medellin Campus, as well as its liabilities or obligations,
shall be transferred to the CNU. The positions, rights, and security
of tenure of faculty members and personnel therein employed.

under existing laws prior to the conversion into regular campus
shall be respected.

All parcels of land belonging to the government occupied by
the CNU-Medellin Campus shall be transferred to the CNU:
Provided, That should the CNU-Medellin Campus cease to exist
or be abolished or should such aforementioned parcels of land be
no longer needed by the CNU, the same shall revert to the local
government unit concerned or the Republic of the Philippines, as the
case may be.

SEC. 7. Suppletory Application. — The provisions of Republic
Act No. 8292, otherwise known as the ‘Higher Education Modernization
Act of 1997”, shall form part of this Act.

SEC. 8. Appropriations. — The amount necessary to carry
out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the annual
General Appropriations Act (GAA).

The Municipality of Medellin shall continue to provide
assistance to the CNU-Medellin Campus until such time that
the amount necessary for the operation and maintenance of the
CNU-Medellin Campus shall be included in the annual GAA.

SEC. 9. Implementing Rules and Regulations. — Within
sixty (60) days from the approval of this Act, the Board shall,
in consultation with the CHED, issue rules and regulations to
implement its provisions.

SEC. 10. Separability Clause. — If, for any reason, any part
or provision of this Act is declared invalid or unconstitutional,
the remaining parts or provisions not affected shall remain in
full force and effect.

SEC. 11. Repealing Clause. — All other laws, presidential
decrees, executive orders, and rules and regulations contrary to or
 
inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are repealed or
modified accordingly.

SEC. 12. Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15)

days after its complete publication in the Official Gazette or
in a newspaper of general circulation.

Approved,

FRANCIS “CHIZ” G, ESCUDERO F.
